subject: DI04019011

h.en: 5.1.1 First accelerate steam, then extract shaft work

body.en:
Start with the situation

A nozzle converts part of steam enthalpy into velocity; a turbine uses the flowing steam to exert torque on rotating blades.

Definition / principle

A prime mover converts energy from a working fluid/source to mechanical output. A steam nozzle is a flow accelerator, not itself a shaft-output turbine.

Understand why

For a steady adiabatic nozzle with no shaft work and negligible potential change:h1+C1²/2000=h2+C2²/2000 withh inkJ/kg andC inm/s.

Application / illustration

Steam jets can drive impulse stages; nozzle flow also serves ejectors and other process duties.

Common mistake / conditions

Pressure reduction alone does not tell whether energy became velocity, shaft work or losses; identify the device model.

Does a diverging passage always accelerate steam?

No. The velocity response depends on Mach number and the compressible-flow conditions.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Nozzle steam enthalpyનો ભાગ velocityમાં ફેરવે;turbine flowing steamથી rotating blades પર torque બનાવે.

Definition / Principle

Prime mover working fluid/sourceની energyને mechanical outputમાં ફેરવે.Steam nozzle flow accelerator છે,પોતે shaft-output turbine નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Steady adiabatic nozzle,no shaft work,negligible potential changeમાં h1+C1²/2000=h2+C2²/2000,h kJ/kg,C m/sમાં.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Steam jets impulse stages ચલાવે;nozzles ejectors,process dutiesમાં પણ કામ આવે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

ફક્ત pressure reductionથી energy velocity,shaft work કે loss ક્યાં ગઈ જાણી ન શકાય;device model ઓળખો.

Diverging Passage હંમેશાં Steam Accelerate કરે?

ના.Response Mach number,compressible-flow conditions પર આધારિત છે.

h.en: 5.1.2 Nozzle shapes, choking and pressure ratio

body.en:
Definition / principle

Convergent, divergent and convergent-divergent passages are geometric types. For compressible flow, area change and velocity response depend on local Mach number and pressure ratio.

Understand why

A converging passage accelerates subsonic flow; when choked, the throat reaches sonic conditions in the ideal model. A properly supplied convergent-divergent nozzle can expand to supersonic flow after the throat.

Common mistake / conditions

A divergent duct does not automatically accelerate all flows; subsonic diffusion commonly slows flow and recovers pressure. Real steam/condensation and losses complicate design.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Convergent,divergent,convergent-divergent geometric types છે.Compressible flowમાં area change,velocity response local Mach number,pressure ratio પર આધારિત છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Converging passage subsonic flow accelerate કરે;choked ideal modelમાં throat sonic થાય.Proper supplyવાળો convergent-divergent nozzle throat પછી supersonic expansion આપી શકે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Divergent duct બધા flows accelerate નથી કરતો;subsonic diffusionમાં flow ધીમો,pressure recover થાય.Real steam/condensation,losses design complex કરે.

body.en:
Given and model

h1=3100, h2=2800kJ/kg, C1=50m/s; ideal steady adiabatic nozzle, negligible height change.

Step-by-step solution

  1. C2=sqrt(C1²+2000(h1−h2))=sqrt(2500+600000)=776.209m/s

Common mistake / conditions

The factor2000 convertskJ/kg to twice kinetic energy; it does not mean every pressure drop has this enthalpy drop.

Does reaction mean pressure drop only in the rotor?

No. Both fixed and moving rows expand steam in the described stage.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

h1=3100,h2=2800kJ/kg,C1=50m/s;ideal steady adiabatic nozzle,negligible height change.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. C2=sqrt(C1²+2000(h1−h2))=sqrt(2500+600000)=776.209m/s

Common Mistake / શરતો

Factor2000 kJ/kgને twice kinetic energyમાં ફેરવે;દરેક pressure dropનું enthalpy drop આ જ હોય એવો અર્થ નહિ.

Reaction એટલે ફક્ત Rotorમાં Pressure Drop?

ના.Described stageમાં fixed,moving બન્ને rowsમાં expansion છે.

h.en: 5.1.4 Steam turbine classes and main parts
h.gu: 5.1.4 Steam Turbine Classes અને Main Parts

body.en:
Understand why

Classify by impulse/reaction principle, axial/radial flow, condensing/back-pressure/extraction service, stage arrangement and compounding.

Main parts include casing, rotor/shaft, moving blades, fixed nozzles/guide blades, bearings, seals, governing/control valves, lubrication and protective trips.

Common mistake / conditions

A turbine stage must be understood as a flow/pressure/velocity sequence; listing blade names without energy conversion is incomplete.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Impulse/reaction principle,axial/radial flow,condensing/back-pressure/extraction service,stage arrangement,compoundingથી classify કરો.

Main parts:casing,rotor/shaft,moving blades,fixed nozzles/guide blades,bearings,seals,governing/control valves,lubrication,protective trips.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Stageને flow/pressure/velocity sequenceથી સમજો;energy conversion વગર ફક્ત blade names અધૂરાં છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Most ideal stage pressure drop occurs in fixed nozzles; moving blades extract work by changing steam momentum.

Construction:part and purpose

Fixed nozzle row expands steam and creates high velocity.

Rotor wheel carries curved moving blades.

Casing directs/contains the flow and exhaust.

Shaft, bearings, seals and protection support mechanical output.

Working:flow and reason

Steam expands in the fixed nozzle, falling in pressure and enthalpy.

High-velocity steam enters moving blade passages.

Blade turning changes angular momentum and exerts rotor torque.

Ideal rotor pressure is approximately constant while absolute kinetic energy is reduced by work and real losses.

Common mistake / conditions

Real blade friction/leakage remain; “impulse” does not mean no pressure anywhere or no energy losses.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Ideal stageનો મોટાભાગનો pressure drop fixed nozzlesમાં;moving blades steam momentum બદલી work લે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Fixed nozzle row steam expand કરી high velocity આપે.

Rotor wheel curved moving blades ધરાવે.

Casing flow,exhaust contain/direct કરે.

Shaft,bearings,seals,protection mechanical output આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Fixed nozzleમાં steam expand,pressure/enthalpy ઘટે.

High-velocity steam moving passagesમાં આવે.

Blade turning angular momentum બદલે,rotor torque બનાવે.

Ideal rotorમાં pressure લગભગ constant,absolute kinetic energy work/real lossesથી ઘટે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Real blade friction/leakage રહે;“impulse” એટલે ક્યાંય pressure નહિ કે losses નહિ એવો અર્થ નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Pressure/enthalpy drop occurs in both fixed and moving blade rows; moving passages also act as expanding nozzles.

Construction:part and purpose

Fixed guide/stator blades orient and partly expand steam.

Moving rotor blades provide further expansion and momentum change.

A drum/rotor, casing and seals control the flow path.

Bearings/thrust arrangements and control/protection manage forces and speed.

Working:flow and reason

Fixed blades guide/expand incoming steam.

Steam enters moving passages with specified relative velocity.

Further pressure drop/relative acceleration and flow turning produce rotor work.

Repeat stages extract energy with declining pressure; seal leakage and axial thrust require design control.

Common mistake / conditions

A50% reaction ideal stage has equal ideal static-enthalpy drops in fixed/moving rows under the stated design; not every reaction stage is automatically50%.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixed,moving બન્ને blade rowsમાં pressure/enthalpy drop થાય;moving passages expanding nozzles પણ છે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Fixed guide/stator blades steam guide,partly expand કરે.

Moving blades further expansion,momentum change આપે.

Drum/rotor,casing,seals flow path આપે.

Bearings/thrust arrangements,control/protection forces,speed સંભાળે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Fixed blades incoming steam guide/expand કરે.

Steam specified relative velocityથી moving passagesમાં આવે.

Further pressure drop/relative acceleration,flow turning rotor work આપે.

Repeat stages pressure ઘટાડીને energy લે;seal leakage,axial thrust designથી control થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Stated designમાં50% reaction ideal stageના fixed/moving static-enthalpy drops equal હોય;દરેક reaction stage50% નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A large pressure/enthalpy drop in one impulse nozzle can produce very high jet speed and an impractically high optimum rotor speed. Compounding distributes the conversion across rows/stages.

Understand why

It aims to obtain practical rotor speed and useful energy extraction while balancing size, cost, stage losses and complexity. It is not simply “adding blades makes efficiency100%”.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

એક impulse nozzleમાં મોટો pressure/enthalpy drop બહુ ઊંચી jet speed,અવ્યવહારુ optimum rotor speed આપી શકે.Compounding conversionને rows/stagesમાં વહેંચે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Practical rotor speed,useful extraction મેળવતાં size,cost,stage losses,complexity balance કરવાના હેતુ છે.ફક્ત “blades ઉમેરો એટલે efficiency100%” નહિ.

body.en:
Understand why

One nozzle set supplies a large pressure drop/high velocity; several moving rows extract kinetic energy with fixed guide/reversing rows between them. The guides redirect flow, ideally without a major pressure drop.

Common mistake / conditions

Absolute velocity falls through moving rows; real guide friction also reduces available velocity. Do not draw a fresh large pressure drop in every velocity-compounding guide row.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

એક nozzle set મોટો pressure drop/high velocity આપે;વચ્ચે fixed guide/reversing rows સાથે અનેક moving rows kinetic energy લે.Guides flow redirect કરે,idealમાં major pressure drop વગર.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Moving rowsમાં absolute velocity ઘટે;real guide frictionથી પણ ઘટે.Velocity-compoundingની દરેક guide rowમાં fresh મોટો pressure drop ન દોરો.

body.en:
Understand why

Pressure compounding(Rateau):divide total pressure drop among successive nozzle/rotor stages. Each nozzle expands steam; each impulse rotor extracts kinetic energy.

Pressure-velocity compounding:divide pressure drop among groups, then use multiple moving/guide rows within each group to absorb velocity in steps.

Write a strong exam answer

  1. Compare using number/location of pressure drops, velocity rise/fall, blade-row sequence and practical speed; draw both pressure and velocity trends against flow distance.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Pressure compounding(Rateau)માં total pressure drop successive nozzle/rotor stagesમાં વહેંચાય.દરેક nozzle expand,દરેક impulse rotor kinetic energy લે.

Pressure-velocity compoundingમાં pressure drop groupsમાં વહેંચો,દરેક groupમાં multiple moving/guide rowsથી velocity stepsમાં લો.

Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Pressure dropsનું number/location,velocity rise/fall,blade sequence,practical speedથી compare કરો;flow distance સામે pressure,velocity trends દોરો.

h.en: 5.1.10 Turbine operation context and exam answer

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Define nozzle/turbine→draw labelled flow path→show pressure/velocity conversion→explain impulse vs reaction→state compounding need/types→applications and losses.
  2. Protection includes qualified overspeed, thrust/vibration, lubrication and steam-condition control; these notes are not a startup/shutdown or trip-testing procedure.
Does an ideal impulse rotor use a large pressure drop for its work?

Its ideal row works mainly through momentum change at near-constant pressure; the upstream nozzle creates the jet.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Nozzle/turbine define→labelled flow path→pressure/velocity conversion→impulse/reaction→compounding need/types→applications,losses.
  2. Protectionમાં qualified overspeed,thrust/vibration,lubrication,steam-condition control આવે;આ startup/shutdown/trip-testing procedure નથી.
Ideal Impulse Rotor મોટો Pressure Drop વાપરે?

Ideal row near-constant pressureમાં momentum changeથી કામ કરે;upstream nozzle jet બનાવે.
